decisions.reason: The renamed 518 FLEX builds on the well-received BASIC 518 and has its own product page, so it is an established, successful trommel line worth keeping.
A dedicated page signals active marketing of the mobile flail shredders, which fit the firm's core mobile processing portfolio.
The grinder is only mentioned, not featured, but one year is too short to judge, and grinders complement the mobile range.
The stationary electric fine shredder has little visibility, yet it serves the tougher processing needs and resource-saving direction the firm targets.
This green-waste grinder overlaps with Product C and is only mentioned, but it serves the composting and biomass customers, so the firm would keep it for now.
Stationary pre-shredders with their own page fit the plant-based business and the push to broaden international activities.
